title: Vertex AI v1beta1: Major Breaking Changes, GenAI Expansion, and Feature Re-rollouts
summary: This Vertex AI v1beta1 update introduces significant breaking changes, making several parameters required and many properties read-only. Developers must adapt to the removal of the `media.upload` method and the retraction of recently added `idpNonce` and `ids` parameters. On the feature side, the API sees a massive expansion in GenAI capabilities, including detailed interaction tracking, new content types, and comprehensive agent task management, alongside the re-introduction of `continuationToken` for long-running GenAI operations.
details:
This is a substantial update for the Vertex AI v1beta1 API, featuring critical breaking changes and a broad expansion of GenAI functionalities.Developers should carefully review their integrations.

**Breaking Changes:**
*   Several parameters are now strictly required: `name` (for operations methods), `parent` (for `collaborativeProjects.create` and `agents.tasks.create`), `task` (for `agents.tasks.deleteArtifact`, `downloadArtifact`, `listArtifacts`, `uploadArtifact`), and `collaborativeProject` (for `collaborativeProjects.artifacts.add`).
*   A large number of properties across various schemas have been made read-only, including `rawPromptToken` and `toolCallUsage` in `GenaiInteractionUsage`, `status` in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1Agent`, and numerous fields within `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1BudgetConsumptionDetail`, `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1CollaborativeProject`, `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1Detector`, `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1EvaluationItem`, `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1EvaluationSet`, `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1Goal`, `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1LinkJsonMetadata`, `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1Task`, and `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1TaskArtifactFile`. Existing code attempting to write to these fields will now break.
*   The `media.upload` method has been removed.
*   The `idpNonce` parameter from `projects.locations.agents.create` and the `ids` parameter from `projects.locations.publishers.files.list` have been removed. These were recently introduced, so developers who adopted them will need to revert their usage.

**New Features & Enhancements:**
*   **GenAI Capabilities:** A significant number of new schemas (`GenaiInteractionUsage`, `GenaiAudioContent`, `GenaiCodeExecutionCallDelta`, `GenaiEnvironmentConfig`, `GenaiFileCitation`, `GenaiGoogleMapsCallDelta`, `GenaiGoogleSearchCallDelta`, `GenaiImageContent`, `GenaiStep`, `GenaiVideoContent`, etc.) have been added, providing granular control and detailed information for GenAI interactions, tool calls (code execution, file search, Google Maps, Google Search, URL context), and various content types.
*   **Agent Task Management:** The `projects.locations.agents.tasks` resource now offers comprehensive methods for `cancel`, `create`, `delete`, `deleteArtifact`, `download`, `downloadArtifact`, `get`, `list`, `listArtifacts`, `patch`, `resume`, `stream`, `suspend`, `upload`, and `uploadArtifact`, enabling robust orchestration of agent workflows.
*   **Collaborative Projects:** New CRUD methods (`create`, `delete`, `get`, `list`, `patch`) are available for `projects.locations.collaborativeProjects`, along with artifact management (`add`, `list`, `preview`, `remove`) within these projects.
*   **Operations Management:** Standard long-running operation methods (`cancel`, `delete`, `get`, `list`, `wait`) are now available for `collaborativeProjects.operations` and `learningSets.operations`.
*   **Detectors:** New resources and methods for managing `projects.locations.detectors` (`create`, `delete`, `disable`, `enable`, `get`, `list`, `listRevisions`, `patch`) have been introduced.
*   **Continuation Token Re-rollout:** The `continuationToken` property in `GenaiVertexV1beta1Interaction` has been re-introduced, allowing developers to resume long-running content generation.
*   **New OAuth2 Scopes:** Two new scopes, `discoveryengine.assist.readwrite` and `discoveryengine.serving.readwrite`, enable broader integration with Discovery Engine products.
